instruction: Run a canary deployment with 10% traffic
output:
kubectl apply -f - << 'EOF'
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: myapp-canary
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: myapp
      track: canary
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: myapp
        track: canary
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: myapp
        image: myapp:canary
EOF

kubectl create deployment myapp-blue --image=myapp:blue && kubectl expose deployment myapp-blue --port=80 && kubectl apply -f - << 'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: myapp
spec:
  selector:
    app: myapp-blue
  ports:
  - port: 80
EOF

output: kubectl describe node node1 | grep -A 10 Allocated

kubectl apply -f - << 'EOF'
apiVersion: autoscaling.k8s.io/v1
kind: VerticalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: myapp-vpa
spec:
  targetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: myapp
  updatePolicy:
    updateMode: Auto
EOF

instruction: Check which pods are controlled by an owner

output:
cat > crd.yaml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1
kind: CustomResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: myresources.example.com
spec:
  group: example.com
  names:
    kind: MyResource
    plural: myresources
  scope: Namespaced
  versions:
  - name: v1
    served: true
    storage: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            properties:
              message:
                type: string
EOF
kubectl apply -f crd.yaml
